entities.name: Warlord of Kroog
entities.description: King of the nation of Yotia near the end of the Time of Legends and father of Kayla bin-Kroog, killed at the Peace Summit.

entities.name: Yotia
entities.description: The nation ruled by the Warlord of Kroog.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: The Warlord's daughter, who married Urza and became Queen of Kroog.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Won Kayla's hand by lifting a statue with an automaton, and later led Kroog's armies.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Used the Weakstone to overload Urza's automaton at the Peace Summit.

entities.name: Rusko
entities.description: A clockmaker to whom Urza was apprenticed for a time.

entities.name: Qadir
entities.description: Leader of the Fallaji who stabbed the Warlord at the Peace Summit.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Fallaji who used the Staff of Zegon to weaken Urza's automaton.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: The people driven from the Sword Marches by Yotia.

entities.name: Peace Summit at Korlinda
entities.description: A summit that broke down over the Sword Marches and ended with the Warlord's death.

entities.name: Fask
entities.description: A man who later claimed the title of Warlord of Kroog.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: Urza's stone, used to try to strengthen the automaton.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: Mishra's stone, which overloaded the automaton.

entities.name: Staff of Zegon
entities.description: A staff Ashnod used to weaken Urza's automaton.

events.summary: The Warlord announces a contest: whoever moves the statue in his square will marry his daughter.
events.quote: he announced a contest that whoever managed to move the statue in his square would be the one to marry his daughter

events.summary: Urza lifts the statue with an automaton and wins the hand of Lady Kayla.
events.quote: Thus, Urza gained the hand of Lady Kayla.

events.summary: At the Peace Summit at Korlinda, talks over the Sword Marches break down into insults and the Warlord activates ornithopters that bomb the dragon engine.
events.quote: the Warlord activated the squad of ornithopters

events.summary: The Qadir stabs the Warlord of Kroog in the chest, killing him.
events.quote: The Qadir drew his saber and stabbed the warlord in the chest, killing him.

events.summary: Urza's automaton chokes the Qadir until Ashnod weakens it with the Staff of Zegon; Mishra's Weakstone makes it explode and the Fallaji flee.
events.quote: Mishra used the Weakstone , overloading it and making it explode

events.summary: Kayla becomes Queen of Kroog and Urza leads the nation's armies.
events.quote: his daughter would receive the title of Queen of Kroog, and Urza would lead the nation's armies

relations.quote: Thus, Urza gained the hand of Lady Kayla.
